edges.falsifier: hyperscaler capex or Marvell design-win conversion weakens materially

edges.falsifier: program delays or share loss prevent expected conversion

edges.mechanism: hyperscalers optimize compute and attach functions for workload, power and cost
edges.falsifier: general-purpose merchant silicon regains economic advantage or Marvell loses design wins

edges.mechanism: larger clusters require faster links across compute and network fabrics
edges.falsifier: architectural shifts reduce Marvell-addressable optical/connectivity content

edges.mechanism: fabless production requires scarce advanced manufacturing and test capacity
edges.falsifier: supply diversifies enough that capacity ceases to constrain ramps

edges.mechanism: program deferral, cancellation or internalization by a hyperscaler can affect a large revenue block
edges.falsifier: customer/program diversification rises while margins remain durable

edges.mechanism: limited wafer/substrate/test capacity can constrain production even with end demand
edges.falsifier: qualified supply becomes diversified and unconstrained
